name: Interest Record 2
definition: Provides transaction specific interest information that applies to the underlying transaction.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of interest included in the entry amount.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the interest amount included in the entry is credit or debit amount.|Usage: A zero amount is considered to be a credit.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Set of elements used to qualify the interest rate.

FromToDate.name: From To Date
FromToDate.definition: Range of time between a start date and an end date for the calculation of the interest.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the interest.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Provides details on the tax applied to charges.
